name: Portable Mini Steam Iron | Handheld Garment Steamer Wrinkle Remover Travel-Friendly
description:
The Portable Mini Steam Iron is your compact 2-in-1 wet and dry garment steamer designed for quick, effortless ironing at home or while traveling. Heating up in just 30 seconds, it produces high-temperature steam to smooth wrinkles from clothes, curtains, and fabrics of all kinds. Its triangular tip and titanium panel ensure precise, even ironing without burns, while the transparent water tank keeps steaming continuous and convenient. Lightweight and travel-ready, it’s the perfect solution for everyday use and on-the-go wardrobes.
Key Features
 Fast 30-second heat-up for instant use
 2-in-1 wet and dry ironing function
 360° triangular tip design for tight spots
 Titanium panel glides smoothly on fabrics
 60ml transparent water tank with leak-proof build
 Lightweight, portable, and travel-friendly design
Ingredients / Materials
Titanium heating panel, ABS body, electronic heating components
How to Use
 Fill water tank with included measuring cup
 Plug in and wait 30 seconds for heating
 Choose wet steam ironing or dry ironing
 Glide over clothes, collars, cuffs, or fabric edges
 Empty tank after use for durability
Package Includes
 1 × Mini Steam Iron
 1 × Measuring Cup
 1 × User Manual
